senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. אזר a. גדר) [to surround,] to help, protect.
units: <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 759:9">Yalk. Num. 759</cite> (play on <he>אל אלעזר</he>, <cite ref="Numbers 19:3">Num. XIX, 3</cite>) <he>אל אל עוֹזֵר</he> (give her, i.e. Rome, over) to the helping God (omitted in Pesik. Par., p. 41ᵃ; <cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 14:1">Pesik. R. s. 14</cite>).
<cite ref="Yevamot 63a:4">Yeb. 63ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Genesis 2:20">Gen. II, 20</cite>) <he>זכה עוֹזַרְתּוֹ וכ׳</he> if he deserves well, she is a help to him &c., v. next w.—
<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 121:1">Midr. Till. to Ps. CXXI</cite> <he>אתם יודעים מי עוזר אתכם עושה וכ׳</he> do you know who is your helper? The maker of heaven and earth.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 44:9">Gen. R. s. 44</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Genesis 15:2">Gen. XV, 2</cite> <he>דמשק אליעזר</he>) <he>שבשבילו רדפתי מלכים עד דמשק וַיְעַזְרֵנִי האל</he> for his (Lot’s) sake I pursued the kings as far as Damascus, and God helped me; a. e.
